subject: Commit term tradeoffs + tranche/soft-start proposal for Dedicated capacity
messages:
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@quadrant.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commit term & soft-start structure for Dedicated GPUs

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Quadrant AI is planning to move our inference traffic for user-facing features to a dedicated GPU pool and we want to lock in predictable economics. A few asks from procurement/engineering: 

- We need pricing for 12/24/36 month reserved commits for an initial pool sized for ~1200 tokens/sec (p95) across multiple models.
- We expect a phased ramp: small alpha in month 1 (10% of committed throughput), then linear ramp to 100% over 3 months. Would like a soft-start where billing ramps with us and some concession on the first invoice(s).
- Throughput guarantees and SLA credits if p95 latency or throughput SLAs aren’t met.
- Any flexibility on start date (we’d prefer a Feb 15 start) and a way to tranche capacity so we don’t pay full commit until after month 3.

Can you share a simple proposal and any standard contract language for the soft-start/tranche? Procurement will want to see invoice milestones if we agree.

Attaching our capacity request doc so you can size pools to our profile.

—Alex
Alex Porter
VP Product
Quadrant AI

Attachment: Quadrant_Capacity_Request_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@quadrant.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit term & soft-start structure for Dedicated GPUs

Alex —

Thanks for the clear requirements and the attachment, that helped a lot. Summary of what we can offer up front (higher-level; I can send a formal quote PDF):

1) Term options (per-month committed spend, with per-token/throughput normalization):
   - 12 months: baseline price (no long-term commitment discount)
   - 24 months: ~18% list discount vs 12m (applies to committed capacity)
   - 36 months: ~26% list discount vs 12m

2) Soft-start / tranche option (to accommodate your phased ramp):
   - Soft-start period: first 90 days default (you can request shorter), during which billed commitment steps up with your actual consumed throughput buckets.
   - For customers who want predictable unit economics during soft-start, we can provide a 30% invoice credit applied to the first two monthly invoices (not to exceed the committed monthly charge) — effectively lowering cash burn while you ramp.
   - Alternatively, we can do tranche billing: 40% of commit billed month 1, 70% month 2, 100% month 4 — concrete schedule configurable in the SOW.

3) Throughput guarantees & SLA:
   - We can offer a throughput SLO tied to p95 latency under the committed load. If we miss the SLO for two consecutive weeks, service credits are available and escalate by severity. Exact numbers depend on the model mix and sequence length distribution — we’ll finalize after capacity sizing.

4) Start date flexibility: Feb 15 start is feasible. We’ll provision a staging pool two weeks prior for smoke testing.

5) Add-ons & ops: Dedicated customers get access to our per-route dashboards and a rollout policy for model variants.

I’ve attached a quick proposal summary (PDF) with a sample tranche schedule and acceptance criteria. If this looks close, I’ll pull in finance/ops and draft a SOW with milestones and an invoice schedule for procurement.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call with procurement + engineering + our capacity team to lock the tranche schedule and SLA numbers. Are you available Thurs 14th or Fri 15th?

Best,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: Redwood_Quadrant_Proposal_v1.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Commit term & soft-start structure for Dedicated GPUs

Karthik / Grace —

Looping you in on Quadrant’s ask and the proposal I sent. Key negotiation points they’ll push on: term length vs discount, a 90-day (or shorter) soft-start that reduces immediate cash burn, tranche billing, and SLA/credit language.

Questions for you: 
- Karthik: can we offer the 18% / 26% discounts as-is for this size of pool (roughly 1200 tokens/sec p95)? Any margin constraints or approval needed?
- Grace: can we make the SLA credits explicit in the SOW (example: X% credit for p95 > target more than Y% of the rolling week)? Also can we commit to staging prior to Feb 15 so QA has the environment?

Also procurement will ask for an invoice milestone schedule (they prefer milestone-based billing tied to activation + ramp). We should propose 40/30/30 or the tranche schedule I included in the PDF. Thoughts?

Thanks — no need for a long reply, a few bullets is fine.

—Marissa

On Mon, Jan 11, 2027 at 11:08 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex —
> 
> Thanks for the clear requirements and the attachment, that helped a lot. Summary of what we can offer up front (higher-level; I can send a formal quote PDF):
> ...

From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@quadrant.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Quadrant AI Procurement <procurement@quadrant.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit term & soft-start structure for Dedicated GPUs

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement and engineering discussed internally and here are our counterpoints: 

- We prefer a 24-month commit (balance of runway and flexibility). To make the commercial side work we’re asking for an additional 8% off the quoted 24m discount for year 1 only (effectively a deeper first-year discount).
- We’d like the soft-start tightened to a 6-month phased ramp in your tranche model (10% month 1, 40% month 2, 70% month 3, 100% month 6) and request that during months 1–3 there be no early-termination penalty if we mutually agree the capacity sizing was misaligned.
- Invoice schedule: Quadrant prefers milestone-based invoicing tied to activation (20%), 50% after reaching 70% of committed throughput, remaining 30% at full activation or month 6 — we can sign if the SLA credit ladder is explicit.

We’ll need your approval on the extra first-year concession and the no-penalty window for months 1–3 (conditional on completing the staging acceptance tests). If you can’t remove the early-termination fee entirely, a capped credit or limited carveout would be acceptable.

We’d like to lock terms early next week; we can do a call Thurs 21st 10am PT.

—Alex

Procurement contact: procurement@quadrant.ai
Doc signing link (proposal draft): https://app.docusign.example/QNT-4721-draft

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@quadrant.ai>, Quadrant AI Procurement <procurement@quadrant.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit term & soft-start structure for Dedicated GPUs

Alex —

Appreciate the clear counter. Quick update from our side: we can agree to 24 months as the baseline and add an additional 6% transient first-year concession (we’re unable to go to 8% without finance approval). On the early-termination carveout: we can provide a conditional limited carveout for months 1–3 provided the staging acceptance tests complete and capacity usage is within the profile you gave us; otherwise standard termination terms apply.

We’ll propose the milestone invoice schedule you requested (20% activation, 50% at 70% throughput, 30% at full activation/month 6). SLA credit ladder and exact thresholds will be in the SOW — we’ll include clear triggers and a two-week remediation window before credits apply.

I’ll loop in finance and legal and send a redline-ready SOW by EOD Monday. Call Thursday 21st 10am PT works for me — adding a calendar invite now.

Next steps:
- I’ll upload a redlineable SOW + quote to DocuSign and share the link.
- Finance will confirm the remaining 2% of concession (if available) during the SOW review.

Speak soon —

—Marissa
